t: What Exosome Targeted Drug Delivery Systems Is
title: What Exosome Targeted Drug Delivery Systems Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Exosome drug delivery uses the body's own nano-vesicles — 30-150 nm membrane bubbles cells use to message each other — as drug carriers: loading them with therapeutics and engineering their surfaces to home in on diseased cells, crossing barriers like the blood-brain barrier that stop conventional drugs. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Exosome Targeted Drug Delivery Systems: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Exosome Targeted Drug Delivery Systems in one line: Exosome drug delivery uses the body's own nano-vesicles — 30-150 nm membrane bubbles cells use to message each other — as drug carriers: loading them with therapeutics and engineering their surfaces to home in on diseased cells, crossing barriers like the blood-brain barrier that stop conventional drugs.
Why it matters: Exosomes are nature's delivery vans: biocompatible, stealthy, and able to reach anywhere..
Where it is used: cancer therapy, brain diseases, gene delivery, regenerative medicine..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
